{{Top|leg}}
The '''Atrakenite Guild of Miners''' was a mining company based on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Trilos]]. Following the [[Battle of Atraken]] and the arrival of [[Atrakenite]] refugees from [[Atraken/Legends|Atraken]] to Trilos, it was decided that the [[Miner/Legends|miners]] already living on the moon would organize the government since they were knowledgeable about the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]]. The Atrakenite Guild of Miners was run by the eight-member [[Mining Council]].
